summary: Phase B — Staff Portal Account panel + Physician Medical Record + Medication lifecycle (add/edit/continue/discontinue) tested end-to-end. 18/18 backend tests PASS against preview URL. Frontend smoke verified: Portal Account panel renders on Maria Lopez with status Active, login_email, email_verified, access, must_change_password, last_login, temp_password_expires visible; Send/Temp/Force-change/Change-email/Disable buttons all have correct data-testids; Send password reset click produced success toast 'Reset code sent to maria.lopez@demo.com'. Medical Record collapsible renders with mr-add-med-btn and mr-active-meds. Portal Access nav badge shows 8 (matches counters.portal_access).

design_issues.screen: Portal Account panel on Patient detail
issues: EMAIL VERIFIED badge shows 'Not verified' for Maria after a staff email change/revert cycle. This is correct per spec (change_email sets email_verified=false and spec says there is NO merge/no auto re-verify), but staff may be surprised that reverting to the ORIGINAL seeded email doesn't re-flag it as verified. Consider adding a small helper text 'Patient must verify via portal' near the badge, or a 'Mark verified' admin override. Non-blocking.

verified_flows: GET /api/internal/patients/{pid}/portal-account returns {has_account, login_email, name, role, status, email_verified, active, disabled, must_change_password, pending_activation, locked, last_login_at, temp_password_expires_at} for Maria Lopez

POST .../portal-account/temp-password -> 200 one-time plaintext temp_password, expires_at set, must_change_password=true, pending_activation=false; login with temp works and /auth/change-password restores Patient2026!
POST .../portal-account/force-password-change -> 200 sets must_change_password=true; verified via subsequent GET; restored via staff temp-password + patient change-password
POST .../portal-account/email with Linda's existing email -> 409 duplicate; change to scratch email -> 200 with email_verified=false; revert -> 200

POST .../portal-account/disable -> 200 active:false; login /auth/login returns 403 'account has been disabled'; patient directory record / PIN remain intact; .../enable -> 200 active:true; login works again (password login returns 200)
GET /api/internal/counters -> includes 'portal_access' integer; preview value = 8 (shown in sidebar badge)

GET /api/internal/patients/{pid}/medical-record (physician) returns summary, encounters, medications.active[Metformin, Ramipril, Atorvastatin + any added], medications.discontinued, documents; patient JWT -> 401/403 (role-scoped)
POST /api/internal/patients/{pid}/medications (physician) adds authoritative row with regimen_key, source=physician_manual, active=true, history event {action: added}
PATCH .../medications/{med_id} with action_type=edit records previous+new in history and keeps active=true
PATCH .../medications/{med_id} with action_type=continue updates last_prescribed_at and keeps/sets active=true

PATCH .../medications/{med_id} with action_type=discontinue sets active=false + discontinued_at, pushes history event; GET /api/portal/medications no longer returns it; GET .../medical-record still shows it under discontinued (history preserved)

UI: Portal Account panel + Medical Record both render for admin after selecting LOPEZ, Maria. All required data-testids present (pa-send-reset, pa-temp-password, pa-force-change, pa-change-email, pa-disable, medical-record-toggle, mr-add-med-btn, mr-active-meds). pa-email-input/pa-email-save and pa-enable render only when the respective edit/disabled state is active — expected.
action_items: INFO: No blocking issues. Phase B is green on both backend and UI smoke. Main agent can proceed.

LOW/UX: Consider explaining to staff that email_verified stays false after any staff-side email change, even when reverted to the original (per 'no merge, no auto-verify' spec). A tooltip or 'Patient must re-verify' hint next to the Not verified badge would help.

INFO (edge not exercised): temp_password expiry 403 path in login() is implemented (lines ~906-915) but was not reproduced in tests because TTL is hours; code path is simple fromisoformat < now compare, considered covered by review.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py get_portal_account response uses `login_email` (not `email`); make sure any other UI consumer of this endpoint keys off `login_email`. Current PortalAccountPanel.jsx renders correctly.

portal_account_change_email also updates db.patients.email but does NOT clear patient.email_verified; patients collection has no separate email_verified flag — only users.email_verified matters for login/UI, so this is fine.

portal_account_disable sets users.active=False only (good). Confirmed login path returns 403 'disabled'. Patient directory, VISITA PIN, patient_medications and portal_access_requests are not touched. Spec compliance OK.

physician_update_medication edit history event stores `previous` and `new` slices only for provided fields — matches spec ('edit records previous+new'). History append on discontinue preserves full record and does NOT remove the document. Good.
GET /internal/counters now returns `portal_access` for both physician and staff branches. Confirmed sidebar badge shows this count.
